messages.subject: Re: RNA-Seq
messages.body_plain:
Dear Patrick,

I tried running CellNet via AWS, however when loading the metadata file using:

> stQuery <- utils_loadObject("metadata.csv")

I get  the following error message:

> Error: bad restore file magic number (file may be corrupted) -- no data loaded
> In addition: Warning message:
> file ‘metadata’ has magic number '<?xml'
>    Use of save versions prior to 2 is deprecated

Do you have a suggestion how I could solve this problem? Unfortunately I'm not an R / programming mastermind.
I also tried loading your metadata file resulting in the same problem.

Best,
Andreas
